_comment: Where to get the Old Hickory Lake shoreline. Run:
which queries the layers below in order until one returns the polygon, then
The USGS National Hydrography Dataset is the authoritative free shoreline for
US inland water. NHD retired from active maintenance in October 2023 but the
data is still published and a reservoir shoreline does not move.
The layer index for NHDWaterbody was not verifiable when this was written, so
several candidates are listed and the fetch tries each. If all of them miss,
run 'gf waterbody:layers <serviceUrl>' to list the layers in a service, then
name: old-hickory-lake
label: Old Hickory Lake

candidates.note: USGS NHD, NHDWaterbody and NHDArea are the reservoir layers

bboxNote: Approximate bounding box for the lake, used to keep the query small and to
prefilter parcel pulls. Verify against the fetched polygon: the fetch prints
the real bbox and warns if it falls outside this one.
